newOpportunities.name: Staro Rīga (Beaming Riga) Light Festival
newOpportunities.what: City-wide light installation festival across Riga's Old Town and public spaces, curated with local and international light artists — 40+ light objects from 10+ countries in a recent edition.
newOpportunities.selection: Curator-led (Diāna Čivle named as festival curator in city press materials); no public open call found.
newOpportunities.requirements: Site-specific light installation proposal rated for Baltic winter conditions.
newOpportunities.intel: No public application page exists. Approach via Riga City Council's communications office and ask to be routed to curator Diāna Čivle — no direct curator email is published. Pitch in spring (Mar-Jun) for the following November's edition.
newOpportunities.warning: Could not confirm a direct curator email — municipal press contact only.

newOpportunities.name: LUNAR Festival of Lights — Urban Pulse International Video Mapping Competition
newOpportunities.basis: 2026 edition's confirmed deadline was 26 Jul 2026 23:59 CET, per organiser's own open-call page; predicting a similar late-July date for 2027.
newOpportunities.money: Jury Prize €10,000; Audience Choice €10,000; Finalist Award €3,000; entry free
newOpportunities.what: International video-mapping competition on Largo facades in central Sofia, part of wider LUNAR Festival of Lights citywide programming.
newOpportunities.selection: Open call, jury-reviewed; 7 finalists project live for jury + audience prizes.
newOpportunities.scale: 22+ light works citywide in a recent edition
newOpportunities.requirements: Application, signed agreement, portfolio, moodboard/storyboard, 120-180s piece.
newOpportunities.intel: Explicitly open to 'artists from around the world', real prize money (€23k pool), but travel/accommodation not covered. Projection-mapping-only format — fits the digital/projection side of the practice more than drone/sphere work directly.
newOpportunities.warning: 2027 deadline is predicted, not yet published — confirm closer to spring 2027.

newOpportunities.name: Light.Move.Festival.
newOpportunities.org: Fundacja Sztuki Światła / City of Łódź
newOpportunities.basis: 2026 edition's confirmed open-call deadline was 2 Mar 2026, per organiser's own page; predicting similar early-March date for the 2027 (17th) edition.
newOpportunities.eventWindow: three evenings, typically May/June, downtown Łódź
newOpportunities.what: 16th-edition (2026) light festival with dedicated categories for large-format projection/mapping, spatial/interactive light installations, and a Debut/Experiment track.
newOpportunities.scale: City-center route through main streets, passages, parks, squares.
newOpportunities.intel: 'Spatial/interactive light installations' category is the best fit for kinetic/LED-sphere work; no fee data published so treat as visibility/relationship-building rather than a primary revenue target.
newOpportunities.warning: Deadline predicted from 2026 pattern; fee levels unconfirmed.

newOpportunities.name: Biela noc (White Night) Bratislava
newOpportunities.what: City-wide Nuit-Blanche-style contemporary art and light festival across dozens of Bratislava venues — 200+ artists, 12+ countries, 50+ locations in recent editions.
newOpportunities.selection: Unconfirmed — a 2022 source named an artistic director not reconfirmed for 2026.
newOpportunities.intel: Multi-source public funding (Slovak Arts Council, city, Visegrad Fund) suggests real budget, but needs direct verification before pitching — contact BKIS (city culture/info centre) rather than assuming any named 2022 contact still holds.
newOpportunities.warning: No current named contact confirmed; do not cite the 2022 artistic director without verifying directly.

newOpportunities.name: Kochi-Muziris Biennale — 7th Edition
newOpportunities.what: Large-scale, multi-venue contemporary art biennale across historic Fort Kochi warehouses and public sites; past editions hosted major kinetic/technology installation work.
newOpportunities.selection: Invitation-only, curator-driven (7th edition curated by Kader Attia, currently in early curatorial research phase).
newOpportunities.requirements: Invitation only — approach curator or foundation directly with portfolio.
newOpportunities.intel: Attia's practice centers on repair, colonial history, collective memory — frame a proposal against those themes rather than pure spectacle. Foundation's general contact form is the only public channel.
newOpportunities.warning: No public submission process; cold approaches via the general form unlikely to reach the curator directly.

newOpportunities.name: Lahore Biennale 04
newOpportunities.basis: Confirmed on lahorebiennale.org: LB04 opens 27 Mar 2027 ('The Shape of Coexistence'), coinciding with the International Biennial Association's General Assembly in Lahore.
newOpportunities.what: Pakistan's international contemporary art biennial, curated by Nav Haq, opening alongside the IBA General Assembly — a historic first for Pakistan.
newOpportunities.scale: City-wide across heritage and public sites in Lahore.
newOpportunities.intel: Foundation is actively building international curatorial relationships now (Sept 2026) ahead of the March 2027 opening — reach out to curator Nav Haq's institution and the foundation together.
newOpportunities.warning: Check current US State Dept travel guidance for Pakistan; drone/rigging logistics need long lead times.

newOpportunities.name: Ayodhya Deepotsav & Varanasi Dev Deepawali — Drone & Light Spectacles
newOpportunities.org: Uttar Pradesh Tourism Dept (via BotLab Dynamics)
newOpportunities.what: UP Tourism stages record-attempting annual drone light shows (500-1000+ drones) at Ayodhya and Varanasi's river ghats, drawing hundreds of thousands of spectators.
newOpportunities.selection: Government-commissioned, produced through incumbent contractor BotLab Dynamics. No open call.
newOpportunities.scale: Riverfront ghats, hundreds of thousands of attendees.
newOpportunities.requirements: No direct artist submission path — realistic entry is as creative subcontractor via BotLab Dynamics.
newOpportunities.intel: Practical entry point is pitching a hybrid drone-plus-live-performer segment to BotLab, India's dominant drone-show company, not to the state government directly.
newOpportunities.warning: Fast-moving state-government cycle; planning details often finalized only 2-3 months ahead.

newOpportunities.name: BotLab Dynamics — Creative Subcontract Partner
newOpportunities.what: India's dominant drone-show company (IIT Delhi spinout), multiple Guinness records, now expanding into Oman and Sri Lanka; default contractor for major Indian government/municipal drone shows.
newOpportunities.scale: 500-2000+ drone shows for government/corporate clients across India and expanding S. Asia/Gulf footprint.
newOpportunities.requirements: Business email with a hybrid drone + live-performance/LED-costuming concept and credits.
newOpportunities.intel: Highest-leverage contact in this territory — holds major government drone contracts but has no in-house acrobatic/LED-costume performance capability, a real gap for a subcontracted creative partner.
newOpportunities.warning: No named individual contact beyond the general business inbox.

newOpportunities.name: Forest/Grounds Immersive Light Experience Commission
newOpportunities.org: Crystal Bridges Museum of American Art
newOpportunities.money: Fee undisclosed; museum (Walton Family Foundation-funded) ran a full Sept-Jan season commission in 2024-25 ('Time Loop' by Klip Collective).
newOpportunities.what: Museum periodically commissions a major touring studio to build a large-scale immersive light/projection experience across its wooded trails, open multi-month.
newOpportunities.selection: Invitation/curated by contemporary art curator; no submission portal or RFQ found.
newOpportunities.scale: Museum-wide outdoor trail installation, multi-month ticketed run.
newOpportunities.requirements: Track record producing large-scale weatherproof multi-month outdoor immersive light experiences.
newOpportunities.intel: Exactly the 'never posted an open call' profile — approach the curatorial team directly with a reel; short flight from Austin.
newOpportunities.warning: Could not confirm program cadence (annual/biennial/one-off) — only one cycle verified.

spec.payNote: Budget undisclosed; past commission implies six-figure production budget.

newOpportunities.name: PULSE Art + Technology Festival
newOpportunities.what: 19-year-running annual art-and-technology festival at the Jepson Center (late January) — video, AI, interactivity, sensor-based installation.
newOpportunities.selection: Curated by Telfair's contemporary art curator; no open call found for any past edition.
newOpportunities.scale: Museum-wide exhibition + multi-day public festival programming.
newOpportunities.intel: Genuinely under-the-radar invitation-only tech-art festival — never surfaces on open-call aggregators. Approach 9-12 months ahead of the January edition.
newOpportunities.warning: No specific curator email confirmed — only a general programs contact published.

newOpportunities.name: Arts at the Airport — Nashville International Airport
newOpportunities.applyLabel: Watch flynashville.com/opportunity for the next call
newOpportunities.basis: Most recent commission (suspended-sculpture, Concourse A) closed 2026-09-04 per flynashville.com; MNAA runs a recurring commissioning program.
newOpportunities.money: $900,000 total budget for the most recent commission; $2,500 design fee for shortlisted finalists.
newOpportunities.what: MNAA runs a recurring public-art commissioning program for BNA concourses, individual commissions in the high six figures.
newOpportunities.selection: Open RFQ via CodaWorx portal, juried by MNAA's Arts at the Airport program.
newOpportunities.requirements: US-resident artist/team with a completed public or private commission in the past 5 years.
newOpportunities.intel: Current cycle just closed — highest-value move is a direct introduction now, ahead of the next RFQ, referencing kinetic/light work.

newOpportunities.name: Tampa International Airport Public Art Program
newOpportunities.basis: 2026 cycle (Phase 2) deadline 2026-03-19 already passed; program runs in phases so a future phase is plausible but undated.
newOpportunities.money: $5.28M total for the 2026 cycle; individual commissions $200,000-$1,200,000.
newOpportunities.what: One of the best-funded airport public-art programs in the US; most recent RFQ explicitly solicited technology-based art for 8 new locations.
newOpportunities.requirements: Public-art execution experience; at least one prior commission valued $15,000+.
newOpportunities.intel: Explicit call-out for technology-based art — worth a direct letter of interest to procurement now for the next phase.
newOpportunities.warning: Named contact (Rayesha Cotton, Senior Procurement Agent) confirmed by title; direct email not independently verified.

newOpportunities.name: III Points Festival — Art Installations Program
newOpportunities.what: Miami's flagship 'music, art and technology' festival (Wynwood, October) with a dedicated large-scale art-installations program billed as 'immersive, glowing environments.'
newOpportunities.selection: Curated internally; festival produced under Insomniac Holdings.
newOpportunities.scale: Multi-stage festival grounds in Wynwood, ~50,000 attendees.
newOpportunities.intel: The festival's own language ('immersive, glowing environments') closely matches this practice. Named production contact (Michelle Concilio, Festival Producer) is a plausible entry point, but expect a longer corporate path via Insomniac/Live Nation.
newOpportunities.warning: No confirmed email for any named staffer.

newOpportunities.name: Fall Art Installation — Sarofim Picnic Lawn
newOpportunities.org: Discovery Green Conservancy (via Weingarten Art Group)
newOpportunities.applyLabel: Watch discoverygreen.com and Weingarten Art Group's Submittable for the next RFP
newOpportunities.basis: One confirmed cycle: 2025 RFP deadline 2025-02-21 via Submittable, $80,000 budget, national eligibility. Recurrence not confirmed.
newOpportunities.what: Downtown Houston's flagship public park periodically issues an RFP for a temporary 4-6 week outdoor installation wanting work engaging day and night with interactive components.
newOpportunities.selection: Open RFP via Submittable, national eligibility.
newOpportunities.scale: Single outdoor lawn installation, 4-6 week run, must withstand 70mph gusts.
newOpportunities.requirements: Outdoor public-art experience; day/night visual interest.
newOpportunities.intel: Smaller budget but low-friction national RFP, good relationship-building entry into Houston's downtown-park ecosystem.

newOpportunities.name: Winter Downtown Activation Program
newOpportunities.org: Ville de Montréal — Service de la culture
newOpportunities.basis: Deadline, funding cap and event window stated on montreal.ca program page, verified 2026-09-14.
newOpportunities.money: Up to $150,000 CAD per project (max 80% of total cost).
newOpportunities.what: City of Montreal funding call for large-scale winter outdoor activations downtown, part of the Downtown Strategy 2030, seeking immersive tech-forward experiences.
newOpportunities.selection: Reviewed by the City's culture service; results announced May 2026.
newOpportunities.scale: Downtown Montreal (Ville-Marie); large installations over a 2+ month run.
newOpportunities.requirements: Lead applicant must be a Quebec/Canadian non-profit or public institution active 6+ months — a foreign or individual artist cannot apply solo.
newOpportunities.intel: Find a Montreal-based non-profit or public institution willing to be the formal applicant/fiscal sponsor and co-apply before 16 Mar 2026 — start outreach now.
newOpportunities.warning: Not directly open to a US sole proprietor — requires a Canadian non-profit/public institution as lead applicant.

gates.note: Individual/foreign artists must partner with a qualifying Canadian non-profit as lead applicant.

newOpportunities.name: Sankofa Square Public Art Commission
newOpportunities.what: Toronto's highest-traffic civic square periodically co-commissions large-scale illuminated/kinetic public art — most recent example a forest of glowing interactive orbs by Montreal studio Kleis, co-commissioned with Quartier des Spectacles and ExpoCité, installed March 2025.
newOpportunities.selection: Past commission chosen via competitive jury process spanning industrial design, public art, literature experts, run jointly with partner institutions.
newOpportunities.scale: Major downtown Toronto plaza; large-scale, high-footfall installation.
newOpportunities.requirements: No open call currently posted — cold-pitch/invitation target based on precedent.
newOpportunities.intel: Reference the Kleis 'Conversations Célestes' precedent directly — frame this as a touring/co-commission candidate in the same vein, proposed to the square's management rather than waiting for a public call.

gates.note: Approach the General Manager's office directly.

newOpportunities.name: LUMINO (Montréal en Lumière)
newOpportunities.what: Montréal en Lumière's outdoor nightly light-art trail through downtown (dusk-11pm), described by the producer as sitting 'at the intersection of creativity and technology.'
newOpportunities.selection: No public open call found — appears producer/curator-commissioned directly.
newOpportunities.scale: Downtown Montreal, multi-block outdoor trail, major corporate sponsorship.
newOpportunities.intel: L'Équipe Spectra/Evenko is a large commercial producer with deep programming relationships — likely commissions light/tech designers directly. Approach via general contact and reference LUMINO by name.
newOpportunities.warning: No named programming contact could be confirmed despite multiple searches.

newOpportunities.name: Flying Canoë Volant — Illumination Program
newOpportunities.what: Annual bilingual winter festival blending Franco-Métis-Indigenous storytelling with an illuminated night trail; current light identity (incl. a 16-foot interactive donation tower) is directly commissioned from a single outside light artist.
newOpportunities.selection: Direct commission by festival organizers, not open call.
newOpportunities.scale: Bois Cardinal / Mill Creek Ravine area; community-scale winter night walk.
newOpportunities.intel: Small budget but a genuine direct commissioner of kinetic/interactive light art with a track record of hiring outside artists — treat as relationship-building rather than a flagship gig.
newOpportunities.warning: Festival reportedly shifting from free-admission to donation-supported model — likely funding constraints.

newOpportunities.name: Illuminate Yaletown
newOpportunities.what: Annual public light-art exhibition/weekend festival across Yaletown, produced by the BIA; past editions built by Vancouver studio Tangible Interaction.
newOpportunities.selection: No open call found — commissioned directly by the BIA, historically via one recurring local partner.
newOpportunities.scale: Yaletown neighbourhood, multi-block outdoor light walk.
newOpportunities.intel: Pitch Mindworks as a marquee out-of-town commission distinct from the returning local vendor, framed around neighbourhood placemaking/rebrand goals. Contact: Sarah Vallely, Executive Director.
newOpportunities.warning: No confirmed budget or open submission process — likely a modest BIA marketing budget relative to typical fees.

insights.title: Develop a relationship with the public art administrator before you apply
insights.role: Public Artist and Public Art Consultant (South Florida)
insights.quote: artists should make every effort to contact the Public Art administrator and develop a relationship
insights.body: Directly applicable to the airport/museum/park commissioners in this scan (Nashville BNA, Tampa airport, Discovery Green) — cold outreach to the named program contact before a call even opens is a real advantage, not a formality.
